paite: Huai lai in Hezekiah, muanmohhuai in achi ana hi. Huchi in Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai akiang ah ahong a, akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Na inkote omdan ding gel in; damkhe zou lou a si ding na hi ngal a," achi hi.
heading: Hezekiah Chinatna Leh Adam Nawnna / (Isa 38.1-8,21,22; 2 Kro 32.24-26)

paite: Huchi in baang lam nga in akihei a, TOUPA kiang ah,
"TOUPA aw, na ma a thutak leh lungtang hoihkim pu a ka omdan leh na mitmuh a thil hoih ka hihdan hehpih in theigige in," chi in athum hi. Huchi in Hezekiah kah petmah in akap hi.
Isai huangsung intual laitak atun ma in hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA thu akiang ah ahong tung hi.

"Kik nawn inla, ka mite heutu Hezekiah kiang ah gen in, TOUPA'N, na pu David Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Na thumna ka za a, na khitui kia leng ka mu hi. Ngai in, ka hon damsak ding a; ani thum ni in TOUPA' inn ah na hohtou ding.
Na damsung kumte kum sawm-le-nga in ka behlap dia; nang leh hiai khopi Assuria kumpipa a pan ka humbit ding.' Keimah ziak leh ka sikha David ziak in hiai khopi ka hum ding, achi," chi in.
Isai in, theipi gah beu khat hon la un, achi a; huchi in ahon la ua, ameimatum ah atat a, ahong dam nawnta hi.
Hezekiah in Isai kiang ah, "TOUPA'N ahon damsak dia, TOUPA' inn ah ani thum ni in ka hohtou ding, chih chiamtehna bang ahi dia?" achi hi.

Isai in, TOUPA'N athil gen ahih ngei ding chih hiai nang a ding in TOUPA a pan chiamtehna ding ahi ding, "Limliap kalbi sawm tan, amailam a akintouh hia na deih, kalbi sawm tan a anunglam a akik?" achi hi.
Hezekiah in adawng a, "Limliap kalbi sawm tan amalam a kintouh abaih tel a, huai zaw hi kei henla, limliap kalbi sawm tan in nunglam ah nungkik zaw hen," achi hi.
Huchi in zawlnei Isai in TOUPA asam a; huchi in Ahaz dak zah theihna a limliap niamsa kalbi sawm tan in nunglam ah akiksak nawn hi.
Huai lai in Hezekiah chi ana chih ana zak ziak in Baladan tapa Babulon kumpipa Merodak-baladan in laikhakte leh thilpiakte Hezekiah akhak hi.
heading: Babulon A Pan Thupawtute

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah in amau ana kipahpih a, athil manpha koihna inn a thil manpha tengteng, dangka, dangka-eng, gimlimte, sathau manpha, agalvan koihna inn teng leh agou koihkhawmna insung a om tengteng a-ensak a: a-inn leh agamsung a Hezekiah in a-etsak louh a-om kei hi.

Huai lai in zawlnei Isai kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah ahong a, akiang ah, "Huai mite'n bang ahia agen uh? Koi a pan na kiang a hong hoh ahi ua?" chi in adong hi. Hezekiah in, "Gam gamla, Babulon a kipan a hong hoh ahi uh," achi hi.
Huchi in ama'n, "Na inn ah bangbang ahia amuh uh?" achi a; Hezekiah in, "Ka insung a om tengteng amu vek ua, ka gou lak ah ka etsak louh a-om kei," chi in adawng hi.
Isai in Hezekiah kiang ah, "TOUPA thu ngaikhia in.
Ngai in, na insung a om tengteng leh tuni tan a na pi-le-pute'n ana kholkhawmte uh Babulon ah apaipih nite uh ahong tung ding; bangmah nutsiat anei kei ding uh TOUPA'N achi.
Na gil a gah, na suan ding, na tapate ngei leng apaimangpih ding ua; Babulon kumpipa' inn ah michilgeh ahi ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Hezekiah in Isai kiang ah, "Na gen TOUPA thu ahoih ahi,” achi hi. "Ka damsung a lemna leh thutak a-om ding nakleh hoih himai lou hia?" achi hi.
Huchi in Hezekiah tanchin dangte, athilhihtheihdan tengteng leh dil leh tuilakna abawl a, khopi sung a tui alaklut thute Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
heading: Hezekiah Vaihawm Tawpna / (2 Kro 32.32,33)

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; atapa Manasseh asik in alal hi.
